name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Navigator and Pilot, one goes with Bauer and the other with Plankton.
Eklund, Navigator, Drift, and Geode belong to different colonists.
Navigator goes with exactly two of Okafor, Echo, and Diatoms.
Geode goes with at least two of Okafor, Medic, and Lumen.
Medic goes with either Drift or Diatoms (but not both).

So Medic does not go with Geode.
